Explore Trincomalee

Ask us on WhatsApp to arrange transport or boat trips.

Pigeon Island National Park

Marine park near Nilaveli, known for snorkeling over coral reefs and reef fish.

Nilaveli Beach

A long stretch of soft white sand with calm, clear water on the east coast.

Koneswaram Temple

Hilltop Hindu temple on Swami Rock with sweeping views over the bay.

Fort Frederick

Historic colonial-era fort in town, great for an evening walk.

Kanniya Hot Wells

A group of natural hot-water wells, an easy half-day stop for families.

Whale & Dolphin Watching

Seasonal offshore cruises from Trincomalee. Ask us about the best months.

Frequently asked questions

How do I make a reservation?

Choose a suite, fill in the short form and send it through WhatsApp. We confirm availability directly and you can pay on arrival.

Which suite is best for a group of 5 or 6?

Room 04, the Grand Family Apartment Suite, sleeps up to 6 with three beds, a kitchenette and a teak lounge area. Room 02 suits 4–5 guests.

Are WiFi and parking included?

Yes, WiFi and parking are free for all guests.

Can you arrange Pigeon Island or whale watching trips?

Yes. Tick the excursion in the booking form and we will confirm the final price and timing with you on WhatsApp.

What are the check-in and check-out times?

We will confirm exact times for your stay when we reply to your WhatsApp request. Call 076 212 1366 for early or late arrivals.
